summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with the eleven members from the spec, each commented with its meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (treated as no variant tags); added public ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, composing the bridge's variant and DualStack lookups and the existing S3/STS predicates. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with one test per behavioral criterion, including the S3 predicate single-call check. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py, and test_regions.py pass (416 tests). No commits made. Notes: the SDK::Endpoint key is always present, with None meaning absent; bridge private lookup methods are used as the spec requires; args.py:315 has a pre-existing overlong line that was left unchanged; all added lines are within 79 columns.
